meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 Codex 替代或配合 Claude 作为智能体规划器
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Claude 之外使用 Codex 作为智能体核心规划器
copy.tagline_en: Use Codex as a full agent provider alongside or instead of Claude
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to use Codex as the primary agent planner instead of or alongside Claude

howto.what: 安装后，你可以让系统使用 Codex（OpenAI 的代码应用服务器）作为完整的智能体提供者，负责规划、工具编排、MCP 工具、服务器端历史记录和会话恢复，可替代或与 Claude 一起使用。
howto.when: 当你通过命令 `ncl groups config update --provider codex` 为特定组设置提供者为 codex 并重启该组后，该组的智能体将切换到 Codex。

say.text: 请将我的项目组切换到 Codex 提供者。
say.note: 执行后该组使用 Codex，记忆自动保留。

say.text: 检查 Codex 是否已安装并可用。
say.note: 运行验证测试，确保注册成功。

howto.what_en: After installation, you can use Codex (OpenAI's code app-server) as a full agent provider for planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, and session resume, alongside or instead of Claude.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you set the provider to codex for a specific group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex` and restart the group.

say_en.text: Switch my project group to the Codex provider.
say_en.note: The group will use Codex; memory persists automatically.

say_en.text: Verify that Codex is installed and functional.
say_en.note: Runs validation tests to confirm registration.
